newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Libyan student accused of killing Iraqi professor.
newsitem.headline: Libyan student accused of killing Iraqi professor.

text.p: A disgruntled Libyan student has been accused of shooting an Iraqi professor working in the Libyan capital of Tripoli, Iraqi diplomats in Tripoli said on Tuesday.

They said that professor Saleh Zaydan Charif, who lectured at the engineering sciences institute in Tripoli, was shot by a student who had failed an exam. The student, who was not named, is under arrest.
